workforce_notice: Assignments are proposed specialist roles, not running agents. No 120-agent runtime or automatic publishing is provided. The fixed creator review runs only bounded, read-only hosted checks; permissions in this registry are descriptive, not a general authorization engine.

repositories.name: darkzOGx/youtube-automation-agent
repositories.installation: Node >=18.17; npm install; Playwright Chromium and FFmpeg for its renderer.
repositories.capabilities: Seven Node workflows, SEO/metadata validation, local scheduling and credential handling.
repositories.decision: Only the dependency-free metadata validator is vendored. Upstream truncates and normalizes input, so ViMax validates first and shows a non-publishing preview. The full server and scheduler are not installed.

repositories.name: gyoridavid/short-video-maker
repositories.installation: Docker recommended; alternatively Node/npm, FFmpeg, Chromium and whisper.cpp build dependencies.
repositories.capabilities: Shorts queue combining stock footage, TTS, transcription and Remotion rendering.
repositories.decision: Not installed: large separate media stack, third-party models and Pexels access; duplicates parts of the local renderer. Windows support is not established by upstream.

repositories.name: adityaarsharma/youtube-marketing-skills
repositories.installation: Node/npm plus Google OAuth and MCP-compatible host; follow INSTALL.md.
repositories.capabilities: YouTube data, analytics, thumbnail, video, comment and playlist operations via MCP.
repositories.decision: Not installed: local plaintext token persistence and broad write scopes do not match ViMax owner-isolated OAuth and explicit approval. ViMax already has a separate private-upload path.

repositories.name: ahmedsakri/youtube-agent-pro
repositories.installation: Python 3; selected heuristics use only the standard library; prompt packs require a compatible agent host.
dependencies: Python standard library for selected scripts
repositories.capabilities: Deterministic idea, funnel, chapter, retention and editing heuristics; not live analytics or forecasting.
repositories.decision: Idea scorer was already integrated; funnel analysis is newly integrated for supplied metrics. Other overlapping/prompt-only scripts are not installed.

repositories.name: Salimzaks/Youtube-content-creation-agent
repositories.license: Unverified: no license file at inspected commit
repositories.installation: Python 3.10+, pip install requirements.txt; search, YouTube and model credentials depend on selected features.
repositories.capabilities: Multi-model research pipeline with search and YouTube integrations; source also contains demo/fallback pathways.
repositories.decision: Not installed: README links an MIT badge but the inspected tree contains no LICENSE file; clarify rights and remove demo-as-real risk before integration.

repositories.name: sergebulaev/youtube-skills
repositories.installation: Python, requests and python-dotenv for clients; plugin instructions target agent hosts.
repositories.capabilities: YouTube URL parsing, API data retrieval, draft skills and optional publishing/image-provider clients.
repositories.decision: Only the dependency-free URL parser is vendored with strict host/path validation. Publishing and network clients are not installed.

repositories.name: realjaymes/marketingagentskills
repositories.installation: Agent-host skill documents; package.json lists optional pptxgenjs; domain utilities have separate runtime needs.
repositories.capabilities: Marketing prompt playbooks and standalone network-oriented scripts.
repositories.decision: Not installed: mostly prompts; overlaps creator planning, and executing networking/scraping would need separate egress and consent review.

repositories.name: calesthio/OpenMontage
repositories.installation: Python >=3.10, FFmpeg and npm/Remotion; optional media/model providers.
repositories.capabilities: Local creative pipeline with media cache, storyboard, scoring, rendering and optional providers.
repositories.decision: Not installed: AGPL distribution/service obligations, large runtime and external-cost/egress controls need legal and security review.

repositories.name: krillinai/OpenCreator
repositories.installation: pnpm workspace with desktop/daemon dependencies and an agent/model runtime.
repositories.capabilities: Desktop daemon with capability tokens, approvals, tasks and media tools.
repositories.decision: Not installed: separate desktop/daemon trust model, large workspace and process capabilities are incompatible with a drop-in Vercel function.

repositories.name: Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft
repositories.installation: Node/npm, Remotion/React, Chromium and FFmpeg for render templates; review bundled asset terms.
repositories.capabilities: Remotion templates, pure motion helpers and a visual workbench.
repositories.decision: Not installed: a separate rendering stack overlaps current media tools; audio/font assets have separate attribution and rights.

repositories.name: FFmpeg/FFmpeg
repositories.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later or GPL depending on build
repositories.installation: Install a compatible FFmpeg binary with libx264 and AAC, or use imageio-ffmpeg; verify the exact binary license.
dependencies: libx264 and AAC for the existing renderer
repositories.capabilities: Audio/video processing and encoding; local ViMax renderer and bounded scene-clip exporter already call FFmpeg.
repositories.decision: Existing local integration; not a hosted online video worker. FFmpeg/model/codec licensing depends on each actual build.

repositories.name: comfyanonymous/ComfyUI
repositories.installation: Separate ComfyUI runtime, PyTorch and downloaded model weights; GPU strongly recommended for demanding video workflows.
repositories.capabilities: Node graph for local image/video/model workflows with a separate HTTP server and extensible custom nodes.
repositories.decision: Not installed: arbitrary custom nodes, network access, model rights, resource isolation and GPL obligations need review. A CPU path exists but may be impractical.

repositories.name: hexgrad/kokoro
repositories.installation: Install Python kokoro/misaki with PyTorch and language-specific phonemizers; download compatible model and voice weights.
repositories.capabilities: Local text-to-speech pipeline with voice/model loading; model and language support require separate verification.
repositories.decision: Not installed: duplicates existing Piper path; large weights and language/model licenses need review. Urdu availability is not assumed.

repositories.name: SYSTRAN/faster-whisper
repositories.installation: Install faster-whisper/CTranslate2/PyAV and a compatible model; CPU supported, CUDA needs matching runtime.
repositories.capabilities: Speech transcription and timestamps with selectable CPU/GPU inference.
repositories.decision: Not integrated: requires reviewed model weights, CPU/GPU resources and a file-isolated worker. An isolated CPU sample with a third-party model package was not usable.

repositories.name: googleapis/google-api-nodejs-client
repositories.installation: Node/npm googleapis client and Google OAuth with only required YouTube scopes.
repositories.capabilities: Official Google API client including YouTube v3 operations and a private upload sample.
repositories.decision: Client not installed: ViMax already implements official, owner-scoped YouTube REST OAuth/Analytics/private upload; adding a second client would duplicate auth and upload behavior.

repositories.decision: Previously vendored and retained; no new upstream audit in this increment.
